issues.description: The problem statement's class diagram and the solution use a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) to add a StockIngredient to the stock, but the template repository provides the same functionality under the different name addItem(StockIngredient). This mismatch between the expected API (problem statement / solution) and the template implementation can confuse students when they try to locate or call the method described in the exercise specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) so the template matches the UML/provided specification and the solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to reference addItem if that name is preferred, but ensure all three artifacts (problem statement, template, solution) use the same method name.
